name: resolve_expression
description: Resolve a Jexs JSON expression through the live resolver and return the result. Pass the expression as JSON (object/array/value), not a string.

expression.description: A Jexs JSON expression to resolve, e.g. { "concat": ["a", "b"] }.

name: list_nodes
description: List every registered Jexs node class and its operation keys (variant ops shown inline), plus the global step keys.

name: describe_op
description: Show the schema for a Jexs operation: description, return type, siblings, variant ops, examples, and the raw schema entry.

name: describe_def
description: Show a $defs shape contributed by a node (e.g. "_routeNode"). Accepts a bare name or a #/$defs/<name> ref.

name: inspect_file
description: Read a Jexs JSON file and report which node operation keys it uses, plus its structure.

filePath.description: Path to the JSON file, relative to the resolver root.
